description: The bar chart presents the evaluation matches between Large Language Models (LLMs) and human annotations on 300 samples, categorized by different types of reasoning tasks. The horizontal axis represents the types of reasoning tasks, while the vertical axis shows the percentage of matches, ranging from 0% to 100%. The chart includes six categories: No Hallucination, Oriented, Active, Self-aware, Rigorous, and Correct. Each category has two bars representing the percentage of matches and not matches, respectively. The 'No Hallucination' category has the highest match percentage at 98.33% and a very low not match percentage of 1.67%. The 'Correct' category also has a high match percentage of 99.00% and a not match percentage of 1.00%. The 'Self-aware' category has a match percentage of 94.00% and a not match percentage of 6.00%. The 'Oriented' category has a match percentage of 97.33% and a not match percentage of 2.67%. The 'Active' category has a match percentage of 97.00% and a not match percentage of 3.00%. The 'Rigorous' category has a match percentage of 95.33% and a not match percentage of 4.67%. The bars are sorted in descending order of match percentage, with the 'No Hallucination' category having the highest match percentage and the 'Rigorous' category having the lowest.
